revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, local-only, later converted into a transparent 768x768 PNG
Asset name: achievement_medal_postcards_tier_007
Primary request: Create one premium collectible postcard achievement medal for tier 7, GOLD rank, second gold medal in the final group of four. Based on the Chinese title concept "很难想象世界上还有你这样完美的人". The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows or gradients.
Subject: exactly one centered circular medal. Inside is a unified funny anthropomorphic postcard/envelope mascot, definitely a rectangular ivory postcard/envelope body with rounded corners and envelope fold lines, tiny cartoon arms and legs, expressive face. Tier 7 gag: the postcard mascot is worshipfully presenting a tiny shiny mirror or halo-like golden frame toward the viewer, looking amazed by perfection; no reflection details, no words.
Medal border: GOLD rank level 2 of 4: richer gold circular ring than tier 6, larger crown ornament, more gems, small symmetrical side fins or small laurel bursts, more sparkles, but not ultimate yet.
Style/medium: polished 3D-like mobile game collectible, glossy enamel and metal, cute humorous center mascot, crisp small-UI readability, same family as travel and foot medals.
Composition/framing: one centered medal only, full object visible, generous padding, central postcard mascot inside circular core.
Lighting/mood: warm glossy highlights, exaggerated admiration and comedy.
Color palette: metallic gold border, ivory mascot, warm golden center, tiny blue-white mirror glint; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no foot, no toes, no shoe, no sock, no animal, no human, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no address lines, no stamp marks, no postmark rings, no watermark, no suitcase, no money pile, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
